sharedRules.name: Line of Command
sharedRules.description:
The range of Line of Command is set to 8”. Any range modifier for Commanding Presence is instead applied to Line of Command. If applicable, the ranges of Commanding Presence and Rally Around the Flag are set to that of Line of Command. While fleeing, a unit loses this rule. Additionally, considering two friendly units with Line of Command:
• If one is in range of the other’s Line of Command, both are always considered to be within range of each other for the purposes of Line of Command, Commanding Presence and Rally Around the Flag.
• While within range of each other’s Line of Command, if one has Commanding Presence or Rally Around the Flag then the other immediately gains the corresponding rule.
• While within range of each other’s Line of Command, if one receives a Stratagem it may forward it to the other instead of applying it for itself.

sharedRules.name: Tsuandan Training
sharedRules.description: Unless Fleeing, the Model is a Trained Model; a unit consisting entirely of Trained Models is a Trained Unit.

sharedRules.name: Imperial Seal
sharedRules.description: If the model is the General it gains +1 Discipline.

sharedRules.name: Military Classics
sharedRules.description: A model with this rule may issue up to the number of Stratagems stated in brackets over the course of the game. Stratagems are issued at the start of friendly Player Turns, targeting a friendly unit within range of the model’s Line of Command. Each Stratagem may only be used once.

sharedRules.name: Fire Lance
sharedRules.description: The model gains Breath Attack (Str 4, AP 0, Flaming Attacks) with a number of hits set to X. All models in a unit must use it simultaneously.

rules.name: Zhuge Nu Repeater
rules.description: Range 18″, Shots 3, Str 2, AP 0, Quick to Fire. The target immediately suffers -1″ Adv (min. 3″) and -1″ Mar (min. 6″) until the beginning of the next friendly Player Turn.

rules.name: Fire Lantern
rules.description: Each Fire Lantern may be used only once. At the start of a friendly Movement Phase, a unit which is not Engaged, Shaken or Fleeing may place one or more of its remaining Fire Lanterns in contact with its Front Facing. A Fire Lantern is a Terrain Feature of 40×40 mm. At the end of step 2 of each friendly Movement Phase, every Fire Lantern on the Battlefield must move 4D3″ in a chosen direction, pivoting freely. A unit which overlaps on a Fire Lantern immediately suffers 3D3 hits with Str 4, AP 0 and Flaming Attacks; models with Fly must additionally take a Dangerous Terrain (1) test which is not considered as caused by a Terrain. Once these effects are resolved, or if it contacts any Terrain other than Open Terrain, the Fire Lantern is immediately removed from the Battlefield.

rules.name: Executioner’s Sabre
rules.description: Two-Handed. Attacks with this weapon gain +1 Str and Lethal Strike. Whenever this weapon inflicts an unsaved wound with Lethal Strike (rolling a natural ‘6’ to wound), the attack gains Multiple Wounds (2).

rules.name: Eunuch
rules.description: For each model part with this option, the model gains Military Classics (+1).

rules.name: Ritualist
rules.description: During Spell Selection, each model part with this option must select one spell among the Learned Spells 1 of Alchemy, Cosmology or Evocation which can cast as a Bound Spell with Power Level (4/8).

rules.name: Sworn Guard
rules.description: The model gains Parry and +1 HP. This model part gains a Halberd and loses Inanimate.

rules.name: Sky Fortress
rules.description: The model gains Fly (6″, 6″), Towering Presence, and must always use Flying movement. The ranges of its Shooting Weapons are increased by 12″ and the distance at which friendly units become additional targets due to Heavenly Gong is set to 12″. The Bastion Hauler model part gains Inanimate.

rules.name: Heavenly Gong
rules.description: The model gains Channel (1), Deafening Clamour and Fortitude (6+). When this model is targeted by an Augment Spell which has been successfully cast, you may discard one Magic Dice: in that case, all friendly units within 6″ immediately become additional targets for the spell.

rules.name: Divine Ordnance
rules.description:
This Artillery Weapon can be fired in two ways:
• Cannon, Range 30″, Shots 2, Str 6, AP 3, Multiple Wounds (D3)
• Range 24″, Shots 2D6, Str 4, AP 1, Area Attack (1×3), Flaming Attacks.
Additionally, each Crew model part gains Sanyan Gun (3+).

rules.name: Ministry of Personnel
rules.description: The model gains Rally Around the Flag.

rules.name: Ministry of Rites
rules.description: The model knows 1 additional Spell and gains a +1 Casting Modifier.

rules.name: Ministry of War
rules.description: The model gains Military Classics (1) and Stubborn.

rules.name: Broad Retinue
rules.description: The model gains 2 additional Court Retinue model parts and its base is changed to 40×40 mm.

rules.name: Tu Si Warlord
rules.description: The model gains Hatred, Not a Leader, can join units containing Insignificant models and may only take up to 75 pts of Special Items. Friendly models with Insignificant within range of this character’s Line of Command gain Hatred.

rules.name: Grand Strategy

rules.name: Neidan Meditation
rules.description: The model gains Inanimate. When applying Fizzle to this model’s failed Casting Attempts, Magic Dices that rolled a natural ’2’ are also returned.

rules.name: Soulbound Bow
rules.description: Range 24″, Shots 4, Str 4, AP 1, Volley Fire. Attacks with this weapon may gain either Flaming Attacks or Divine Attacks (all simultaneous Attacks must receive the same Attribute).

rules.name: Divine Pillar
rules.description: Throwing Weapons. Shooting & Close Combat Attacks made by the model can gain Area Attack (1×2) or Area Attack (2×1), in which case they suffer -1 AP.
